# OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER (q) Incident Command Training

> Online training for on-scene incident commanders and HAZMAT team leaders, meeting OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120(q) and 29 CFR 1926.65(q), including the incident commander requirements of 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(v). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Regulation: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120(q) and 29 CFR 1926.65(q)
- Duration: about 8 hours; 5 modules, 55 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.8 CEU
- Price: $199.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Other formats: SCORM, virtual instructor-led, in-person
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device; English and Spanish; audio option
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months
- Renewal: OSHA requires 8 hours of annual refresher training for incident commanders; renew by retaking this course
- Wallet card: optional add-on, mailed within 2–3 weeks

## Who it is for
On-scene incident commanders; people who lead or oversee incident command operations; HAZMAT team leaders; managers of facility or site emergency response plans; Incident Command System (ICS) coordinators.

## Modules
1. Incident Command System and Emergency Response Planning (13 lessons)
2. Legal and Reporting Requirements (3 lessons)
3. Hazard Recognition, Toxicology and Safety (12 lessons)
4. Personal Protective Equipment and Respiratory Protection (12 lessons)
5. HAZMAT Operations and Decontamination (15 lessons)
